name: Shop suspension, unspecified violation of policies
distinguishing_phrases: we are unable to share further details

intake.label: What date did Etsy suspend the shop?
intake.why: The appeal opens with the shop name and the date.

intake.label: What is your shop name?
intake.why: Etsy matches appeals by shop name.

intake.label: What does your shop sell, in one or two sentences?
intake.why: Etsy's appeal is short. The first thing the reviewer needs is what the shop actually is.

intake.label: Which policy do you think this relates to, and why?
intake.why: Etsy rarely says. An appeal that engages with a specific policy beats one that asks what happened.

intake.label: What changed in the shop in the two weeks before the suspension? (new listings, new supplier, bulk edits, a spike in orders, a new device or location)
intake.why: Most unspecified suspensions trace to one recent change. Finding it is the appeal.

intake.label: Do you or anyone in your household have another Etsy shop?
intake.why: Linked accounts are a frequent, unstated cause.

intake.label: Have your bank details, address or identity documents changed recently?
intake.why: Payment and identity mismatches trigger automatic suspensions that read as policy violations.

intake.label: Do you use production partners, and are they declared on your listings?
intake.why: Undeclared production partners are one of the commonest true causes.

intake.label: What have you already corrected, and on what dates?
intake.why: Corrective actions carry dates on Etsy too.

evidence.label: The suspension email
evidence.why: We quote Etsy's wording exactly and check whether a policy is actually named.

evidence.label: Screenshots of your main listings
evidence.why: Lets the appeal describe the shop concretely.

evidence.label: Supplier or materials invoices, if you buy components
evidence.why: Supports the handmade or sourcing part of the appeal.

evidence.label: Identity or bank verification documents, if Etsy asked for them
evidence.why: Where the cause is verification, documents end the case faster than an appeal.

sections.heading: What the shop sells
sections.guidance: Two or three sentences: the products, the materials, how they are made, how long the shop has traded.

sections.heading: How the shop complies
sections.guidance: Address the policy you believe is at issue, point by point, with specifics from the shop.

sections.heading: What has changed
sections.guidance: Dated bullets of what has already been corrected.

sections.heading: Evidence attached
sections.guidance: One line naming each attachment and what it shows.

output.opening: One sentence naming the shop and the suspension date, and asking Etsy to state the policy at issue if it is not named.
output.closing: One short line offering any further document Etsy needs.

rejection_patterns.fail_message: Etsy's appeal box takes 2000 characters. Anything longer is cut off mid sentence.

rejection_patterns.check: No paragraph scores above 0.6 for genericity.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This paragraph could belong to any shop. Etsy Trust and Safety reads hundreds of these a day.

rejection_patterns.check: The appeal engages with a specific policy rather than only asking Etsy what the violation was.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An appeal that only asks what happened gets the standard reply. Name the policy you think applies and address it.

rejection_patterns.check: None of: unfortunately, I assure you, please give me one more chance, loyal seller, unfair.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: This phrase appears in rejected appeals more than in accepted ones. Remove it.

rejection_patterns.check: No [MISSING: ...] markers remain in the draft.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: A required fact is missing. Answer the question rather than letting the draft generalise.
A correction with no date reads as a promise, not an action taken.

rejection_patterns.check: Where another shop exists in the household, the appeal declares it.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: An undeclared second shop is usually found. Declaring it first is better.

rejection_patterns.check: Where production partners are used, the appeal says whether they are declared.
rejection_patterns.fail_message: Undeclared production partners are a common cause of unspecified suspensions.

submission.where: The appeal link in Etsy's suspension email, or Etsy Support, Contact us
steps: Open the suspension email and use the appeal link it contains.
Paste the appeal as plain text. It must fit in 2000 characters.
Attach the evidence where the form allows attachments; otherwise offer it in the text and send on request.
Send once and wait. Repeated appeals slow the queue.
submission.turnaround: Etsy typically replies within 3 to 7 days.
